description: This PHP class named FormatWithTime implements a value formatting strategy to format DateTime objects into a time string (H:i:s). It is part of the orangehrmMaintenancePlugin, specifically in the FormatValue namespace, and implements the ValueFormatter interface.

classes.name: FormatWithTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into 'H:i:s' time string format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted time string from a DateTime object, or null if the input is not a DateTime instance.
